text: i see you added a general notes but am i wrong that u didnt add any way to write a note or am i blind
resolution: The '+ add note' affordance existed in the spec (field count showed 2) but rendered invisibly because it was laid out off the panel's right edge — diagnosed jointly with the user as a width/clip issue, fixed under req_0924. Confirmed the notes group always ends with a writable add-note chip plus per-note text fields.
